jobs.description:
Hey you! 👋 Do you want to blast away as a warehouse employee in Best and immediately tap into a delicious salary of €15,83 per hour? 💸 Then working at BMN might just be perfect for you! At this building materials company, they are looking for hard-working people. Grab this unique challenge and score that fixed day shift right away! 🎉

What we offer
- A great salary of € 15,83 per hour (21+)💰
- Good support during your onboarding
- Chance of a permanent contract🤝
- Grow into a controller
- Working in a fixed and chill day shift
- Prospect of a permanent contract at BMN

Who you are
To be able to perform this job well, you meet the following requirements as a warehouse employee. 💪 Ready to go? 🔥

- You speak Dutch or English
- You are available for 32 to 40 hours a week
- You are willing to work in Best
- You are available during the week
- You are available for shifts between 7:00 and 18:00
- You are physically able to walk a lot

What will you do
Your workday as a warehouse employee is incredibly varied and secretly a very nice walk! 🏃‍♂️ With your own trolley, you navigate on foot through the aisles and pick all orders via the hand scanner. 📱 Because of this active role, your shift really flies by in the blink of an eye! 🛒
Briefly summarized:

- Digitally scanning hardware such as screws so that the online stock is always perfectly correct;
- Steering your trolley smoothly through all aisles so that contractors get exactly their right nuts;
- Collecting the orders flawlessly so that you can grow lightning-fast into a controller.

Where will you work
Welcome to BMN in Best, the place where you as a warehouse employee end up in a truly warm bath! 🏢 You absolutely taste a great atmosphere here where all colleagues know each other personally and always help each other forward. 🤝 Hard work is highly appreciated here and celebrated weekly with a good dose of humor! 🥳

Financial Controller | 77 K | High Tech | Rotterdam - Rotterdam Vacatures Rotterdam 
Ready to accelerate your finance career in a fast-growing high-tech scale-up? This is your opportunity. 
 Organisatie 
For an innovative international high-tech company based in Rotterdam, we are looking for an ambitious Financial Controller. You'll join a dynamic finance team where technology, growth and continuous improvement go hand in hand. This is your chance to make a real impact while helping build the finance function of an international scale-up. 
We would love to speak with professionals interested in the position of Financial Controller.

As Financial Controller, you'll combine analytical strength with a hands-on mindset. You'll have the opportunity to optimise processes, collaborate with multiple departments and contribute directly to the continued growth of an innovative international business. 
 Wat heb je nodig? 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting or a related discipline. - Strong knowledge of NL GAAP and IFRS, with several years of experience in a similar finance role. - Experience with ERP systems and advanced Excel skills. - Proactive, analytical and eager to improve processes. - Comfortable working in a fast-paced international environment with excellent English communication skills.

Are you looking for an energetic weekend job where you can put your leadership skills into practice? Do you want to earn extra money on Saturdays while guiding a diverse team of warehouse workers? BPO Services is looking for a proactive Team Leader in Breda! You get to decide whether you are an early bird or prefer working later in the day.

What we offer
- A salary up to € 33,23 gross an hour
- A dynamic role to boost your management skills
- An official contract directly with BPO Services
- A welcoming, international team atmosphere
- A fixed Saturday schedule and your choice of shift
- Travel allowance

Who you are
As a Logistic Team Leader you are a natural motivator who leads by example. You keep a cool head when things get busy and know exactly how to keep your team energized. Furthermore

- You are available to work every Saturday for one of the two designated shifts.
- You have an excellent command of the English language (our main language on the floor).
- You preferably have some experience in logistics, warehousing, or a supervisory role.
- You are decisive, responsible, and focus on both safety and efficiency.

What will you do
As a Logistic Team Leader at BPO Services, you are the engine of the weekend operation. On Saturday they are working in 2 shifts, you can choose which shift suits you best: 06:00 - 15:00 OR 15:00 - 00:00. You will start your Saturday by briefing your team, ensuring everyone knows their targets for the day. Throughout your shift, you walk the floor, coordinate the workflow, and jump in to help solve any bottlenecks. Furthermore you will be:

- Coaching, guiding, and motivating your team members.
- Monitoring the daily logistics targets and adjusting the planning where necessary.
- Ensuring a safe, clean, and positive working environment.
- Handling administrative tasks and communicating with the Shift Manager.

Want to learn how your designs can contribute to a sustainable world? Then apply for an internship at Kraaijvanger Architects, an innovative and resilient architectural firm in the heart of Rotterdam. 
You will work as a full-fledged colleague in our driven, multidisciplinary design teams. We will involve you in all aspects and phases of the design process. You will contribute to design research, concept development, plan development, studying models, and drafting presentations. Thanks to your colleagues, you will quickly feel at home in the workplace. Everything you learn with us will give you a head start in your career in architecture. 
We are Kraaijvanger : good for people and the planet! 
Our mission is to design spaces with a positive social and ecological footprint in a rapidly changing world. We create timeless architecture that brings people and nature closer together. We create buildings where people enjoy spending time and that contribute to a healthy living environment. Our work is internationally recognized: we are the first B Corp architectural firm in Rotterdam. 
Our office is located in the center of Rotterdam, where we work with around 60 professionals on a wide variety of exciting projects. Urban renewal, public buildings, innovative industries, housing, healthy interiors, renovations, and other special projects. Take a look at our projects on our website. 
Are you ready to take on the challenge? 
This internship is part of your master's degree at the TU Delft. What talents do you bring to the table? You can create diagrams and visualizations in Rhino and have experience with Photoshop and Illustrator. We model our designs in Revit and create presentations in InDes...

As an evening shift operator, you are the key player in the production process. You work full-time in the evening shift and ensure that all injection molding machines run smoothly. You'll receive clear digital work instructions and support with starting up, adjusting, and maintaining the machines. This is a great opportunity to develop yourself: there are plenty of growth opportunities and you can take training courses. This position is for the long term, so you can really build your future here.

You start your working day by checking your workspace and the machines. Then you get started operating the injection molding machines, carrying out production work, inspections, and packaging tasks. You keep a close eye on the process, perform quality checks, and make sure everything runs neatly and safely. Teamwork is important: together you and your colleagues make sure everything runs smoothly in the evening shift.

Are you the evening shift operator who gets energy from technology and enjoys working together? Apply now and make a difference in this modern production environment!

- 

- You have a vocational education, preferably technical

- You speak good English

- You work accurately and pay attention to quality

- You are flexible and willing to work evenings

- You have an affinity with technology and machines

Job Description:

- Loading and unloading trucks and containers
- Receiving goods by checking part numbers and quantities, including quality checks
- Accurately picking, packing, and unpacking orders for spare parts
- Applying shipping labels on packages and pallets
- Administering in ERP/WMS system or on paper
- Conducting cycle counts of inventory
- Quality control of products with defects
- Moving, sorting, and storing products in the correct locations

Job Requirements:

- At least 2-3 months of experience in a warehouse environment
- Possession of a valid reach truck and forklift certificate
- Good command of the English language, both spoken and written
- Driver's license B is a plus
- VCA certificate is a plus
- Team player

Are you an experienced MIG/MAG Welder looking for a stable, long-term position in a modern production environment? In this role, you will work on high-quality steel constructions used in demanding industries where precision and craftsmanship are essential. You'll become part of a professional team that values quality, innovation and personal development.
OrganisatieOur client is a leading manufacturer of complex steel constructions and high-precision components for international customers in industries such as high-tech, semiconductor, energy and optics. Working with modern production equipment and advanced manufacturing technologies, the company offers a stable working environment where quality, innovation and employee development are key priorities.
Functie - Perform MIG/MAG welding on steel constructions
 - Assemble products based on technical drawings and welding instructions
 - Set up and operate welding equipment
 - Inspect weld quality and dimensional accuracy
 - Prepare finished products for Quality Control
 - Maintain a safe, clean and organized workplace
 - Contribute to continuous improvements within the production process
 
Functie-eisen - MBO-level education or equivalent technical working and thinking level
 - Proven experience as a MIG/MAG Welder
 - Experience welding steel constructions
 - Able to read technical drawings independently
 - Good command of the English language
 - Willing to work in a two-shift rotation, with the possibility of moving into three shifts
 - Accurate, quality-driven and safety conscious
 
Aanbod - A gross monthly salary between €3,200 and €4,900, depending on your experience
 - 16% shift allowance for working in a two-shift rotation
 - Opportunity to move into a three-shift schedule with a 25% shift allowance
 - The opportunity to secure a permanent contract after an initial secondment period
 - A full-time position (40 hours per week)
 - A modern production environment with high-quality equipment

Job description: Emirates Cabin Crew are responsible for delivering the Fly Better onboard experience to passengers across our global network. As a member of our Cabin Crew team, you will be the onboard representative of our brand, delivering our signature award-winning service while maintaining world-class safety standards. In the role, you will ensure the safety and comfort of our passengers, manage onboard service and maintain cabin cleanliness throughout each flight. You will respond to passenger requests, working collaboratively with your fellow colleagues to ensure a smooth flight. You will also uphold the highest of service standards in line with the Emirates Fly Better promise. Candidate profile: To be considered for Emirates Cabin Crew, you’ll need to be: Fluent in written and spoken English (additional languages are an advantage) A natural team player with a personality that shines At least 160cm tall and able to reach 212cm high Able to meet the UAE’s employment visa requirements At least 21 years old And have: At least 1 year of hospitality or customer service experience A minimum of high school (Grade 12) education No visible tattoos while in Emirates Cabin Crew uniform Salary information: Your salary includes a fixed basic pay and variable flying pay, which is calculated using number of hours you fly during the month. Salaries are paid monthly. What the company offers: Emirates offers career progression opportunities as you grow in knowledge, skills and confidence. From providing the best customer experience in Economy Class to leading the whole team as purser, we always strive to provide our staff with development pathways that matches your personal and professional ambitions. All Emirates Cabin Crew enjoy a wealth of personal benefits. Furnished accommodation is provided free of charge, with utilities being paid for by the company. When you’re on duty, you’ll enjoy free company transport between your accommodation and the airport/training college,

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Employee AS Watson Afternoon Shift (125154002)
jobs.description:
For our Kruidvat warehouse in Ede, we are looking for a part-time or full-time supply chain employee for the afternoon shift.

Together with your colleagues, you ensure that everything runs smoothly and orders leave the warehouse on time. As a supply chain employee, you will work in two departments. In the picking department, you collect products using a headset and scanners. You know exactly where everything is located in the warehouse and ensure that every order is complete and correct.

In the packing department, you ensure that the products are properly packed and ready for shipment. For this, you use protective materials, labels, and shipping documents.

You will work the afternoon shift from 16:00 – 00:00.

- You are available 2, 3, 4, or 5 days a week
- You speak Dutch and/or English
- You are available to work on Saturdays once every 4 weeks
- Do you need a work permit? We are happy to help you with your application!
- You can work from 16:00 to 24:00

jobs.occupation: Assembly Worker Canon Production Printing Venlo (229528)
jobs.description:
One of the biggest companies in the print industry is looking for you! Do you already know who we are talking about? None other than Canon of course! Canon Production & Printing is looking for assembly workers to put printers together. In return, you will receive a gross starting salary of €15.81 per hour and you can even get a direct contract with Canon! Want to know more about this job? Then read on quickly and apply today!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for assembly workers in Venlo for Canon.

As an assembly worker, you will assemble printers based on manuals. Your main tasks will be:

    - Assembling printers based on manuals
    
- Requesting parts from colleagues in the Logistics department
    
- Using technical insight to connect the right printer parts with each other

What's in it for you

    - Gross starting salary from €15.81 per hour
    
- Full-time job of 40 hours per week
    
- Travel allowance of €0.21 per kilometer (starting from 10 kilometers one way)
    
- Temporary employment contract via Manpower with the possibility of a permanent contract with Canon if you perform well
    
- Free development opportunities via the Manpower Academy, where you can follow more than 200 online courses
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Year-end bonus (13th month)

    - Minimum MBO working and thinking level
    
- Availability of 40 hours per week
    
- Proven affinity with technology (this can come from work experience, education, or your hobbies)
    
- Good command of the Dutch and English language, both spoken and written, is required due to work tasks and safety on the shop floor

Is this your new job and do you want to be considered? Then apply today before the vacancy closes and Manpower will contact you within two working days!

Samenvatting Step into the fast-paced world of logistics as an Orderpicker in Zoetermeer area?. This role gives you hands-on experience, growth opportunities, and a supportive team environment. If you’re looking for a fresh start and want to develop real skills, this is your chance. Good work!Over de functieAs an Orderpicker in Zoetermeer area, you play a crucial role in the logistics process. Using a handheld scanner, you make sure every item is picked accurately and efficiently. You’ll also help pack orders, label shipments, and occasionally assist with unloading goods from trucks. The work environment is dynamic and active, with a focus on teamwork and precision. You’ll be on your feet, moving around the warehouse, and working with colleagues to meet daily targets.
- Picking and collecting products in the warehouse using a handheld scanner and EPT
- Labeling and preparing orders for shipment
- Assisting with unloading deliveries and organizing goods
- Maintaining a clean and safe work environment
- Communicating clearly with your team to meet targets

You work Monday to Friday, with shifts between 7:00 and 16:00. Some flexibility during busy periods may be required.
Over het bedrijf
Within this logistics company in Zoetermeer area, you’ll find a team that values efficiency, reliability, and good communication. The company specializes in fast and accurate order processing for clients across the region, using modern systems and a well-organized warehouse. You’ll work alongside colleagues who are supportive and eager to help new team members settle in. The atmosphere is open, with a mix of experienced staff and newcomers, and there’s always music playing to keep the energy up. If you’re looking for a place where you can learn, grow, and be part of a close-knit team, this is it.
Wat wij vragen- Own housing in the Netherlands required. No accommodation provided.
- No previous experience required – full training will be provided
- Basic knowledge of Dutch, Englis

Samenvatting Ready to roll up your sleeves and get moving in a dynamic warehouse environment in Amsterdam? From loading and unloading to sorting packages, every day is an opportunity to stay active and energized. Whether you're handling lightweight parcels or heavier loads, this job lets you show your strength and speed. It's the perfect fit for those who enjoy teamwork and a physically engaging role. Over de functieJoin our energetic team in Amsterdam as a Warehouse Worker and be part of the engine that keeps things moving!
In this active role, you’ll be responsible for loading, unloading, and sorting packages of all shapes and sizes. Some are light and easy to handle, while others require a bit more muscle — perfect for those who enjoy physical work and staying on their feet.
Don’t worry if you only speak a little English or Dutch — basic communication is enough to get started. What really matters is your motivation, your ability to work hard, and your willingness to roll up your sleeves and get the job done.
This is your chance to work in a supportive team, stay fit, and make every day productive and rewarding. Sound like your kind of job? Good work!
You'll be working in 2 shifts:
- 15:00 - 23:00
- 23:00 - 07:00

Over het bedrijfDHL eCommerce, part of the DHL Group, is a global leader in logistics and supply chain management. With operations in over 220 countries, we’re the engine behind millions of packages reaching their destination every day. In our Amsterdam location, you’ll be working in a fast-paced, well-organized environment with people who value teamwork, respect, and reliability.
We don’t just move packages — we move businesses forward. And we couldn’t do it without the people who power our warehouses.
Wat wij vragen- Basic understanding of English or Dutch (low level is sufficient)
- Physically fit and able to perform heavy lifting and manual tasks
- Team player with a positive and proactive attitude
- Willing and able to work in a 2-shift rot
